title: Wear OS watchface ambient mode brightness
body:
Can someone add a selector for brightness on the ambient mode? It's so bright that i can't even sleep with that flashlight lol

I would do myself but i don't know where to start and this seems like an easy task for any experienced out there

EDIT: Or... since ambient mode has a setting for "low color" (everything white), can that color be configurable? Defauling to #FFFFFF, this way i can set it like #888888, resulting in less brightness

comments.body:
I'm trying on my own, but i'm stuck here and need some help please.

Changes: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/commit/121616b792b1e956f13e8ba3085b39abc96c34ca

This 10 options that i've added should change low bit mode to this colors:

```
1: #1A1A1A
2: #333333
3: #4D4D4D
4: #666666
5: #808080
6: #999999
7: #B3B3B3
8: #CCCCCC
9: #E6E6E6
10: #FFFFFF
```

But i don't know how to implement it or if it's even possible. Where in the code is the white color set?

All i found is this:

```
        if(lowResMode ^ isLowRes(watchMode)){ //if there was a change in lowResMode
            lowResMode = isLowRes(watchMode);
            setColor();
        } else if (! sharedPrefs.getBoolean("dark", true)){
            //in bright mode: different colours if active:
            setColor();
        }
```

So... it's just `setColor()`. I don't know where white is set

@jamorham You implemented low bit mode right? Can you give me a hand please?

I think this is relevant but i'm not sure how to change it :( https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/blob/master/wear/src/main/java/com/eveningoutpost/dexdrip/Home.java#L184-L211
